lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy4Au2Sn2 (Dy2AuSn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au in a tetrahedral environment with 4 Sn neighbors, Dy in a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 neighbors (4 Au, 8 Dy), and Sn coordinated by 4 Au atoms. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-sharing between Au tetrahedra and Dy 12-vertex polyhedra, plus face-sharing between Au tetrahedra and Dy polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 8 sites.
